# manami sample

`sample.jsonl` has the shape of the `.jsonl` release asset of
[manami-project/anime-offline-database](https://github.com/manami-project/anime-offline-database)
(ODbL 1.0 + DbCL 1.0). The first two anime are real entries from release 2026-27 (trimmed); the others are
synthetic edge cases for the parser (unknown sites, ambiguous IDs, zero episodes).
